scientific_integrity: All-dimensional proof uses a Jacobi triple product and Zak fiberization; finite checker diagnostics are supplementary and not infinite certificates.
scientific_limitations: Integer time-frequency lattice; exactly d+1 translates of one tensor Gaussian; conservative general frame bounds; sharp quadratic asymptotic only for the displayed two-dimensional family. Equivalent specialized earlier constructions cannot be excluded.
title: Coordinate separation and quadratic collapse for minimal Gaussian multiwindow Gabor frames
